lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 fixed the file-size ratchet gate failure that the reviewer found in round 1. US-007 is operator-required (dogfood) and will exit with BLOCKED_OPERATOR_REQUIRED.
